title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression is used to predict the probability of a binary outcome. The model is defined as: $$P(y=1|x)$$ $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{1+e^{-\left(\theta_0+\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2\right)}}$$.

title: Model Parameters
text: The given model parameters are $$\theta_0=-3$$, $$\theta_1=1$$, and $$\theta_2=\frac{1}{2}$$. Use these to calculate the probability for $$x_{new}$$.

title: Substitute $$x_{new}$$ into the Model
text: Substitute $$x_1=1$$ and $$x_2=4$$ into the logistic regression equation: P(y=1|x_new) $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{1+e^{-\left(\theta_0+\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2\right)}}$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: Calculate the linear combination: $$\theta_0+\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2$$.

title: Calculate the Probability
text: Use the linear combination to find the probability: P(y=1|x_new) $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{1+e^{-0}}$$.
